scope: Explicit CPU package view, no HTTP/PD/MTP/NPU work; not deployed
baseline_class: Actual AsyncDynamicbatchTokenizer imported after full SGLang tokenizer loader
candidate_application: Subclass of verified base, collection loop override only, same actual inherited _process_dynamic_batch
semantic_change: No await for future arrivals after first queue item; drain get_nowait until cap/budget/queue-empty. Same cap/window fields do not imply same batching semantics.
required_scenarios: Staggered arrivals with recorded actual enqueue times and observed batch groups
Cancelled enqueued future and surviving requests
Injected tokenizer exception then same actor recovery
Repeated batches, cleanup and no pending futures
oracle: Direct actual tokenizer result for each exact text/kwargs; full dict and ID comparison. Expected cancellation/exception states tested explicitly.
instrumentation: Separate untimed correctness probe; delegating wrapper may count call size/kwargs and inject failure only in named cases. Do not use wrapper timing as clean performance.
environment: Reuse L011 repaired cgroup discovery and successful CPU-only image controller, hashes and4RO model files; new owned container ID/tag; no new devices or service mutation
acceptance: Functional states and values preserved; batch splitting and arrival tradeoffs disclosed. No performance acceptance or whole-task baseline promotion.
